arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. O'Neil argued the order simply requires moving an inmate between two secure buildings.
Mr. Flowers argued the Sixth Circuit created new opportunities for prisoners to litigate.
Ms. Reaves stated federal courts may order state prisoner transport in rare circumstances.

paragraphs: This case tests the limits of federal power over state prison operations. The core issue is whether a federal court can compel a state to move a prisoner for a medical test.
